pages.title: Between worlds
pages.text: Spirit Form is the first power you should master. It frees you from the usual limits of a physical body.$(br2)In Spirit Form, you can:$(li)fly;$(li)pass through blocks;$(li)see in darkness;$(li)ignore ordinary damage.

pages.title: The cost of intangibility
pages.text: Hunger is the main limit of Spirit Form. Moving in this state consumes hunger according to the distance travelled. When your hunger runs out, Spirit Form ends.$(br2)A cooldown may apply after returning to your normal state. Do not let the freedom of flight make you forget the cost of coming back.
